description: Human-owned list of architecture-affecting surfaces the facts observer must see. Register a surface here; do not infer or auto-extend this list.

canaries.why: Agency constellation and graph producer. PR 1076 raised the PASSPort constellation ceiling on this surface; graph-row ceilings are invisible to the observer's closed source set.
Agency SearchDocument producer. PR 1076 touched this file; it is absent from the observer's closed source set, so constellation/search-producer changes do not appear in facts.
Materializes the agency constellation lookup and documents. Constellation producers and their materializers sit outside the observer's closed source set.
Keyword-index builder for typed SearchDocuments. PR 1058 changed it with production search; the observer does not parse tools/build_* builders.
Civic Graph catalog counts. Already in the observer's closed source set; registered so coverage of this surface is explicit rather than implicit.
Pages-edge document renderer. Search, Browse, and Pages-edge sit outside the observer's closed source set.
Pages worker invocation boundary. A route family handled in the edge renderer but missing from this include list never reaches the worker.
C4 materialization_tools cites this builder as the seam that writes compact site read models. The observer does not parse materializers.
Production Worker search federates collection families. Adding a family (PR 1058 Committees) does not change dispatch pathnames, so the route parser stays quiet.
Production bindings, routes, and crons. The reconciler already checks this file against C4; registered so the already-observed surface stays in the canary set.
